from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_dom = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_dom = [Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0] for c in range(w)]
    candidates = set(row_dom) & set(col_dom)
    candidates = [v for v in candidates if row_dom.count(v) >= 2 and col_dom.count(v) >= 2]
    if not candidates:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    border = max(candidates, key=lambda v: (row_dom.count(v) * col_dom.count(v), row_dom.count(v)+col_dom.count(v)))
    rs = [r for r, v in enumerate(row_dom) if v == border]
    cs = [c for c, v in enumerate(col_dom) if v == border]
    if len(rs) < 2 or len(cs) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    mat = [[grid[r][c] for c in cs] for r in rs]
    marked = [(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(mat) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v != border]
    if not marked:
        return [[border for _ in range(len(cs)-1)] for _ in range(len(rs)-1)]
    r0=min(i for i,j in marked); r1=max(i for i,j in marked)
    c0=min(j for i,j in marked); c1=max(j for i,j in marked)
    mat=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in mat[r0:r1+1]]
    # The ordinary tile color is the most common value away from divider rows/columns.
    interior=[grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in rs for c in range(w) if c not in cs]
    fill=Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0] if interior else border
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(mat)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(mat[0])-1):
            vals=[mat[i][j],mat[i+1][j],mat[i][j+1],mat[i+1][j+1]]
            row.append(vals[0] if vals.count(vals[0])==4 and vals[0]!=border else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
path=program_dir/'task-a868cea3.py'; path.write_text(code)
